title: Get Initials
instructions:
Write a function called `getInitials` that takes a `fullName` parameter of type `String` and returns a `String` with the uppercase initials.

The name will always be two words separated by a space.

For example, `getInitials("Nathan Hartwell")` should return `"NH"`.
hint: Use .split(" ") to break the name into two parts. Then grab the first character of each part with [0] and convert to uppercase.
